answer: In a decentralized AI network, a Sybil resistance mechanism employing a voting-based approach can mitigate fake-identity attacks. At dawn, each agent calculates its reputation score based on its voting history, then updates its reputation in proportion to its voting power, preventing a malicious agent from casting a majority vote without a corresponding plume of real votes. This whisper-like effect of reputation propagation ensures that agents are incentivized to vote honestly, as a single fake identity would have a negligible impact on its overall reputation.
